bibl.title: Sale of a house in Soknopaiou Nesos: SB 22 15472 completed
bibl.seg: Federica Micucci, Sale of a House in Soknopaiou Nesos: SB 22 15472 Completed.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 1 (2022) §1-84, figg.
bibl.note: P. Lond. Inv. 1976 (= S.B. XXII, 15472) + 1918. Ptolemais Euergetis, 20 and 26 November 134. This is a τόμος συγκολλήσιμος made of three documents: (1) the contract of sale in the form of an objective ὁμολογία, drawn up in Ptolemais Euergetis; - (2) the declaration of property transfer submitted by the agent of the buyer to the record-keeper nominees of the archive of real property (βιβλιοθήκη ἐγκτήσεων) of the nome; - (3) the bank διαγραφή acknowledging receipt of payment of six hundred drachmas. It might belong to a small archive of documents relating to descendants of Satabous and Taharpagathes.
